It also syncs the stale D-09/D-10 matrix rows and the runbook current-status line. Per the Lead's addendum, PH-396 'v1.0 leftover-task reconciliation and closure (docs)' was registered ready (deps=[], kind docs, risk S, spec docs/v1.0-development/closure-reconciliation.md) and its spec was created in this PR, covering the ~115 open tasks/legacy chains with evidence-based close/partial→new-slice/keep-with-gap conclusions and the final v1.0 delivery + blocker lists; this slice only registers it and does not execute the reconciliation. No code, scripts, migrations, contracts or gates changed; no real PG/browser/production execution or acceptance pass is claimed.
